# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `talkif` MCP server pointing at `https://api.talkif.ai/api/v1/mcp`.
- Auth uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and Dynamic Client Registration — no API key to configure.
- Logo: Talkif's official mark.
- Skill `talkif`: how to work the Talkif inbox, hand work to other sessions, and when to ring the user.
